title: malaxis lamii
intro: Malaxis lamii, commonly known as the Malaxis orchid or green adder's mouth, is a species of orchid native to Central and South America. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties, which help in relieving cough and congestion. The therapeutic actions of Malaxis lamii include its antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it effective in treating various infections and inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Malaxis lamii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
